name: typed-usage-lists
goal: Group consumers by module type and reserve screenshot previews for visual modules

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Used In combines module types; all hover previews request screenshots even for nonvisual service and helper modules. Reserve screenshot UI for visual categories.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing entity relations tests check uses headings only. entityPreviewFunctions checks mixed footer links but accepts a screenshot placeholder for the nonvisual Order store. Extend both standard assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen browser matrix at 7eabf80a9 fails on missing typed consumer headings/lists; immutable run fb920774 retained before screenshots.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Reuse declared-category grouping in relationship sections and shared footer. Keep visual screenshot renderer; nonvisual previews use code names without screenshots. Existing standard matrix is the guard.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Shared usageGroups feeds reverse dependency headings and footer lists; nonvisual tooltip skips evidence/image lookup and renders code name plus role.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged 6-case desktop/tablet/mobile browser matrix passes at 39af962d0; pinned run 362e9dc9 matches red runtime/environment and frozen test corpus.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated 39af962d0 archive with old relation/footer renderers restored fails 3 assertions; restoring exact repaired files passes all 13 tests. Logs retained under .cache/harness/typed-usage-lists.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
